name: Cyprodenate
summary: Cyprodenate (Actebral) is a stimulant drug. It was used for counteracting the effects of benzodiazepine tranquillizer drugs before the development of newer antidotes such as flumazenil. It produces dimethylethanolamine as a metabolite.

uses.text: It was used for counteracting the effects of benzodiazepine tranquillizer drugs before the development of newer antidotes such as flumazenil.

pharmacology.en: It is broken down in the body to dimethylethanolamine (DMAE), a compound related to choline. How it counters the sedation of benzodiazepines is not well understood.
pharmacology.zh: 它在體內會分解成與膽鹼相關的二甲基乙醇胺（DMAE）。它如何抵消苯二氮平類的鎮靜作用，目前仍不清楚。
pharmacology.zhHans: 它在体内会分解成与胆碱相关的二甲基乙醇胺（DMAE）。它如何抵消苯二氮平类的镇静作用，目前仍不清楚。

fact.en: Cyprodenate is an ester that joins DMAE to a cyclohexyl acid. The body splits it apart, which is how it releases DMAE.
fact.zh: Cyprodenate 是把 DMAE 與一種環己基酸結合的酯類。身體會把它拆開，因而釋出 DMAE。
fact.zhHans: Cyprodenate 是把 DMAE 与一种环己基酸结合的酯类。身体会把它拆开，因而发布 DMAE。
